categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates as a semiconductor IC distributor focusing on network communication ICs, including wired broadband components, wireless communication components, optical communication components, voice processing components, and communication protection components. It also provides technical support and value-added services to customers. Additionally, the company engages in international trade and information software services.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced semiconductor technologies related to network communications, including Bluetooth BLE wireless communication, AI chips for edge computing, and WiFi Halow for long-distance digital image transmission. It provides integrated hardware and software solutions, focusing on product design support and sample testing, but does not engage in manufacturing itself.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include manufacturers of network, multimedia, cloud storage, IT infrastructure, and communication products. The company serves industries related to information and communication technology, targeting both domestic and international markets with a focus on network communication semiconductor components.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in Taiwan and Mainland China, with sales distributed approximately 36% domestic and 64% international. It also has subsidiaries and investments in Hong Kong, Singapore, and Shanghai, supporting its Asia-Pacific presence.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company functions as a midstream semiconductor component distributor, acting as a critical bridge between upstream semiconductor manufacturers and downstream product manufacturers in the information, network, and communication sectors.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategically, the company focuses on expanding its network communication IC product lines, enhancing technical support services, and investing in related industries to increase operational synergy. R&D efforts emphasize AI applications in traffic monitoring, wireless communication solutions for electric vehicle charging, and edge AI with long-distance wireless image transmission modules.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through product sales of semiconductor components and related electronic parts. The company also earns income from technical support services and value-added solutions provided to customers. It does not rely on subscription or licensing models.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Major competitors include large global IC distributors such as Arrow, Avnet, Wenya, and WPG Holdings. Despite being smaller in scale, the company positions itself as a leading domestic IC distributor specializing in network communication components, leveraging niche products and strong technical support to maintain competitive advantage.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In the latest fiscal year, the company reported consolidated revenue of approximately NT$45.9 billion, a decrease of 18.08% from the prior year, but net profit after tax increased by 27.13% to NT$762 million. The company maintains a solid financial structure with a debt-to-asset ratio of 69.54% and a return on equity of 14.61%, indicating stable profitability and moderate growth.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes professional technical support and comprehensive total solutions in network communication semiconductor components, differentiating itself through specialized service and value-added engineering assistance. Its focus on niche product lines and strong customer relationships in the network communication sector enhances its market position and customer loyalty.
